fullTextEN: Hello everyone, I am Xiaoxiao!
I am from Henan, China.

fullTextZH: 我非常喜欢毛茸茸的动物，
fullTextEN: I really like furry animals,
Furry.
I think they are very cute.

fullTextZH: 你们喜欢毛茸茸的动物吗？
fullTextEN: Do you like furry animals?
Like raccoons, pandas,
and another kind of animal,

fullTextZH: 它们外形也是毛茸茸的，
fullTextEN: They also look furry,
Its name is weasel.

fullTextZH: 你们知道黄鼠狼是什么动物吗？
fullTextEN: Do you know what kind of animal a weasel is?

fullTextZH: 它的外形有点像可爱版的老鼠，
fullTextEN: Its appearance is a bit like a cute version of a mouse,

fullTextZH: 不过它们的毛发是黄色的，
fullTextEN: But their fur is yellow,
Their bodies are longer,
Their necks are also longer,
Their ears are sharper.
So,

fullTextZH: 黄鼠狼整体看上去比老鼠要大一些。
fullTextEN: Weasels overall look bigger than mice.

fullTextZH: 但是，它们不是同一种动物。
fullTextEN: However, they are not the same kind of animal.
Sometimes,

fullTextZH: 黄鼠狼会把老鼠当作自己的食物。
fullTextEN: Weasels will consider mice as their food.
In Chinese culture,

fullTextZH: 对黄鼠狼和老鼠的评价都不太好。
fullTextEN: Both weasels and mice are not well regarded.
Because weasels come out at night,
sneaking into people's yards,

fullTextZH: 把人养的鸡给偷偷吃掉。
fullTextEN: and secretly eat the chickens people raise.
You think,

fullTextZH: 如果有一只动物天天跑到你的院子里，
fullTextEN: if an animal comes to your yard every day,

fullTextZH: 把你自己家养的鸡给偷偷吃掉，
fullTextEN: and secretly eats the chickens you raise,
would you still find it cute?
Would you still like it?

fullTextZH: 但是呢，在中国东北地区，
fullTextEN: However, in Northeast China,

fullTextZH: 人们觉得黄鼠狼不是普通的动物。
fullTextEN: people think weasels are not ordinary animals.
Weasels are deified,
They think

fullTextZH: 黄鼠狼有可能会变成“黄鼠狼精”。
fullTextEN: weasels might turn into 'weasel spirits'.
If you are not good to them,
they might take revenge on you;
if you are good to them,
they will repay you.
Here, there is a legend:

fullTextZH: 一个村庄里面有一个猎人叫老李。
fullTextEN: In a village, there was a hunter named Lao Li.
Lao Li's family was very poor,

fullTextZH: 每天靠打猎赚钱来生活。
fullTextEN: and he lived by hunting every day.

fullTextZH: 有一天，老李上山去寻找猎物，
fullTextEN: One day, Lao Li went up the mountain to look for prey,
As he walked, it got dark.

fullTextZH: 这个时候再下山已经来不及了，
fullTextEN: By this time, it was too late to go back down the mountain,

fullTextZH: 老李决定在山上休息一晚，
fullTextEN: so Lao Li decided to rest on the mountain for the night,
and return home the next morning.

fullTextZH: 老李在山上找了一个山洞，
fullTextEN: Lao Li found a cave on the mountain,
and prepared to rest in the cave for the night.
At that time, the weather was very cold,
so Lao Li collected some firewood,

fullTextZH: 准备在山洞里点火取暖。
fullTextEN: and prepared to light a fire in the cave to keep warm.

fullTextZH: 突然，老李看到了一个奇怪的影子，
fullTextEN: Suddenly, Lao Li saw a strange shadow,
which startled Lao Li.

fullTextZH: 一开始，老李以为山洞里有其他的人，
fullTextEN: At first, Lao Li thought there were other people in the cave,

fullTextZH: 于是决定转过头去打个招呼：“你好！”
fullTextEN: so he decided to turn around and say hello: "Hello!"
But as he turned around,
It really scared Old Li.

fullTextZH: 原来，老李的身后不是人，
fullTextEN: It turned out, behind Old Li was not a person,
but a weasel.
This weasel was very strange,
not only stood like a person,

fullTextZH: 并且头顶上还盖了一片树叶，
fullTextEN: but also had a leaf on its head,

fullTextZH: 远远看去，就像戴了一顶帽子。
fullTextEN: from a distance, it looked like it was wearing a hat.

fullTextZH: 老李心里想着：“一只黄鼠狼而已，
fullTextEN: Old Li thought to himself: "It's just a weasel,

fullTextZH: 他打死的黄鼠狼可多了。”
fullTextEN: he has killed many weasels."

fullTextZH: 不过，像这种不害怕人的黄鼠狼，
fullTextEN: However, a weasel that is not afraid of people,
he saw for the first time.

fullTextZH: 突然，黄鼠狼张口说话了：
fullTextEN: Suddenly, the weasel opened its mouth and spoke:
"Do I look like a person to you?"

fullTextZH: 黄鼠狼居然开口说话了！
fullTextEN: The weasel actually spoke!

fullTextZH: 这一说话，可把老李吓得不轻。
fullTextEN: This speaking really scared Old Li.
In his whole life,

fullTextZH: 还没有见过会说话的黄鼠狼。
fullTextEN: he had never seen a talking weasel.
He was so scared he couldn't speak.
The weasel saw he didn't answer,
and took a few more steps forward,

fullTextZH: 继续问他：“你看我像个人吗？”
fullTextEN: He continued to ask him: 'Do I look like a person to you?'
Old Li was in fear,

fullTextZH: 想起了村里面的老人曾经对自己说过：
fullTextEN: He remembered what the village elders once told him:

fullTextZH: “黄鼠狼是非常容易成精的动物。
fullTextEN: 'Weasels are animals that can easily become spirits.

fullTextZH: 但是，黄鼠狼在成精之前，
fullTextEN: However, before a weasel becomes a spirit,

fullTextZH: 就会问一个人：‘你看我像个人吗？’
fullTextEN: it will ask a person: 'Do I look like a person to you?'

fullTextZH: 如果他得到的回答是‘你像个人’，
fullTextEN: If the answer it receives is 'You look like a person',

fullTextZH: 那么这个时候，黄鼠狼就可以变成人。
fullTextEN: then at that time, the weasel can become a human.
If the human's answer is 'No,
you don't look like a person',

fullTextZH: 那么黄鼠狼就不能变成人。
fullTextEN: then the weasel cannot become a human.

fullTextZH: 但是，你要好好回答它的问题，
fullTextEN: However, you must answer its question carefully,

fullTextZH: 不然黄鼠狼就会报复你。”
fullTextEN: otherwise the weasel will take revenge on you.'
Old Li was still thinking,

fullTextZH: 黄鼠狼已经等得不耐烦了。
fullTextEN: but the weasel was already getting impatient.

fullTextZH: 于是，黄鼠狼继续问：“你看我像个人吗？
fullTextEN: So, the weasel continued to ask: 'Do I look like a person to you?
Do I look like a person to you?
Do I look like a person to you?'
Old Li was interrupted in his thoughts,
and hurriedly said: 'Yes,
You look like a person,
You look exactly like a person!"

fullTextZH: 话说完，老李就晕了过去。
fullTextEN: After finishing speaking, Old Li fainted.

fullTextZH: 等到老李再醒过来的时候，
fullTextEN: When Old Li woke up again,

fullTextZH: 已经是第二天的早晨了。
fullTextEN: it was already the next morning.

fullTextZH: 于是，老李赶紧下山回到村庄里。
fullTextEN: So, Old Li hurried down the mountain back to the village.
After a month passed,
in Old Li's home

fullTextZH: 渐渐出现了一些奇怪的事情。
fullTextEN: some strange things gradually appeared.
Old Li has two children,

fullTextZH: 他的大儿子之前身染重病，
fullTextEN: his eldest son was previously seriously ill,
his health was very poor,

fullTextZH: 他的小女儿身体也不好。
fullTextEN: and his little daughter was also not healthy.

fullTextZH: 但是，后来他们的身体都渐渐变好了。
fullTextEN: However, later their health gradually improved.
People in the village all said,

fullTextZH: 这是黄鼠狼给老李的回报。
fullTextEN: this was the weasel's reward to Old Li.

fullTextZH: 这就是黄鼠狼成精的故事。
fullTextEN: This is the story of the weasel becoming a spirit.
In your country,

fullTextZH: 有什么动物成精的故事吗？
fullTextEN: are there any stories of animals becoming spirits?

fullTextZH: 请在评论区留言告诉我吧！
fullTextEN: Please leave a comment and tell me!
Bye!
